units.source_text: 我体弱，不论跑步还是练单杠都输给人家，再加上天生结巴，我就愈加畏首畏尾了。

en.t: I was physically weak, and whether it was running or practicing on the horizontal bar, I always lost to the others; on top of that, I was born with a stutter, so I became more and more timid.

units.source_text: 而且大家都知道我是寺庙住持的孩子。

en.t: Besides, everyone knew that I was the child of the temple priest.

units.source_text: 顽童们模仿口吃和尚结结巴巴诵经，在取笑我。

en.t: The mischievous boys mocked me by imitating a stuttering monk stumbling through a sutra chant.

units.source_text: 说书说到结巴的侦探出场的段落，他们就故意让我念给他们听。

en.t: When a storytelling passage came to the part where a stuttering detective appeared, they would deliberately make me read it aloud for them.
